name: Tute habanero
description: Two-player Tute variant with eight cards each and a stock; same as Tute corriente except capote (announce to take all last eight tricks). 40-card Spanish.

overview.description: Two-player Tute variant with eight cards each and a stock; same as Tute corriente except capote (announce to take all last eight tricks). 40-card Spanish.

history.origins: Tute habanero is a Tute variant played with a 40-card Spanish deck in Spain and Cuba.
timeline: 20th century: Tute habanero variant documented in Spain and Cuba; eight cards each, capote (take all eight tricks after stock exhausted).

setup.players: Two players only; no partnerships. Each plays for themselves. Head-to-head variant of Tute (same as Tute corriente) with eight cards each, a face-up trump card, and a face-down stock. Non-dealer leads first; after each trick both players draw from the stock until it is exhausted, then follow suit and beat or trump.
setup.dealing: Eight cards each, one at a time; next card turned face up for trump; remainder forms stock face down.

rules.objective: Be first to reach 101 or more points from tricks, singing (20/40), and last trick (10); or declare tute (four kings or four horses) after winning a trick to win immediately; or announce capote when stock is exhausted and take all eight remaining tricks to win (lose one trick and opponent wins).
rules.gameplay: Same as Tute corriente except eight cards each instead of six. Non-dealer leads. Until stock exhausted: no follow suit or trump required; second player may play any card. Winner of trick draws from stock first, then opponent; face-up trump is last card drawn. After stock empty: must follow suit and beat if possible, trump if cannot follow. After winning a trick, may sing one 40 or 20; tute wins the game. When stock is exhausted, either player may announce capote and must then take all eight remaining tricks to win. Trump 7 or 2 may be exchanged for turned card. Wrong claim of 101+ loses.
keyRules: Capote: announce when stock empty to take all eight tricks

scoring.winCondition: First to 101+ points, or declare tute (four kings or four horses), or succeed at capote (take all eight tricks after stock exhausted); wrong 101 claim loses.
